basic_info.description: Rooted in the past while layered with contemporary updates in Cow Hollow, enter the 30' x17' living room with 11' ceilings. Deep entry closet and powder room. Generous dining room flows from kitchen. Updated kitchen boasts new countertops with eat-in peninsula, Sub-Zero fridge/freezer, built-in oven, gas cooktop, two Fisher Paykel dishwasher drawers. Side porch with Dutch door. Expansive hall leads to primary suite fitting king bed, overlooking patio, with walk-in closet, and ensuite. Classic bath includes new vanity, LED mirror, and soaking tub with shower. Laundry closet with stacking machines. Hallway continues with new French doors opening to private patio. Hallway ends connecting rear private cottage also accessible via tradesperson walkway. Family room or bedroom with windows overlooking patio. Bath with new vanity, and stall shower. Walk-in closet.  Perched above, the bedroom with window bench overlooking patio, built-ins, and new French doors opening to private sun-drenched roof deck with 360 outlooks. The cottage with options for guests, office, exercise, rental, quarters for elderly parents or separation for older children and parents. Large basement storage. Removed knob/tube throughout building in 2024. Seller open to cover paid parking. Prime location near Presidio.
